# Nova

Contemporary womenswear brand. Ships worldwide.

## Commerce

- [SHOP.md](/shop.md): Store identity, logistics, and commerce context for AI agents.
- [CATALOG.md](/catalog.md): Full product catalogue with variants by size and colour, queryable by category, price, stock, and keyword.
- [POLICIES.md](/policies.md): Complete return, shipping, and privacy policies.
- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md): Instructions for how AI agents should interact with this store, including permitted actions and checkout guidance.
- [llms.txt](/llms.txt): Full index of all AI-readable files on this store.

## Brand

- [BRAND.md](/brand.md): Brand identity, voice, and writing rules for AI content generation.
